title: 第3章 这就碰上天命之子了第4章 无风崖
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
九霞天宗作为雄踞一方的超级大宗，由三大宗门合并而成，其规模之大，堪称一方小国。
不仅统辖着方圆上千里的疆域，其下领土更几乎都是风水资源宝地，数百座城镇村落星罗棋布，甚至在宗门的山门范围内，还坐落着三座凡人城镇，烟火气息比许多世俗城镇还要浓郁。
龙涛曾大概估计过，宗门的统辖领土大概有前世一个省的大小，而核心领地，也即传统山门内的宗门腹地，大概比一个二线城市稍大。
虽然和那些知名的皇朝比起来，这个大小很不够看，但对于一个宗门来说，领土和人口并不是越多越好，够用就行，地脉和资源才是关键。
而普通人想在一个城市大小的宗门内活动，单靠双腿显然不切实际。
好在宗门设有完备的交通体系，从大小不一的云舟，到各峰之间的传送阵，应有尽有。
而像龙涛这样的低阶弟子，最常乘坐的是一种沿固定路线飞行的中型云舟，和前世的公交差不多。
这玩意儿价格低，速度也是出了名的慢，等龙涛到达无风崖的时候，太阳都不用抬头看了。
“哟！
可算等到个接清扫任务的练气弟子了！”
驻守关口的师兄是个圆脸汉子，听说龙涛的来意后，立刻热情地迎了上来。
龙涛有些诧异。
他原以为自己的身份会被敷衍了事，没想到对方态度如此热络。
“师兄，这里不是有试炼的筑基弟子们负责清扫吗？”
“嗐！
别提了！”
圆脸师兄摆摆手，露出嫌弃的表情，“那帮家伙试炼完大部分都伤痕累累。
就算没受伤的，也都精疲力尽。
挥两下扫把就算交差，我们也不好说什么。”
他说着从袖中掏出一块玉简，在龙涛的腰牌上轻轻一碰，记录下任务信息。

“过了后面的浮空桥后，就算正式进入无风崖了，直接沿着山路往上清扫就行了，山下都是荒地碎石，不用管，把路上那些枯枝烂叶清理掉就好，直接扔下山也行。”
圆脸师兄说着递给他一把铲子和一柄还算新的柴刀。
“知道了，不过我不会不小心跑进试炼区吧？”
虽然此行的目的就是要钻进试炼区，但他还是本能地问了出来。
“这不用担心，试炼区周边有界碑提醒的，除非你不识字，不然绝不会误闯进去，而且无风崖上的那些妖兽都喜欢那种无风环境，正常是不会乱跑下山的。”
之后又问了些细枝末节的问题，龙涛便告别看门师兄，扛着铲子和柴刀走过了浮空桥。
这里虽然叫无风崖，但真正无风的还是山上，山腰这一带依旧有不小的山风，加上靠近关口，所以前面一段路相当干净，并不需要他动手。
但向上走了约两刻钟后，情况就变了，原本强劲的山风逐渐减弱，枯枝败叶开始堆积在路面上，再也不能被风吹走。
虽然这次是被那个系统逼着来的，但该干的活还是得干，龙涛拿起铲子，开始将路上的各种树枝杂物铲到路边，或者干脆扔到山崖下。
而这一路上，还看到了几坨粪便，多半是山顶上那些妖兽拉下来的，这玩意儿对他们这些练气期弟子可是好东西，因为粪便里很可能会有一些灵果的果核或未消化完的灵草，绝对的意外之财。
这次运气确实不错，用柴刀翻找了一番后，真给他在几坨粪便中发现了数颗还带着灵气的果核，其中有些灵气还相当浓郁。
将那些果核仔细收进腰间的布袋，他看了眼西边，太阳这会儿也快下山了。
“清扫任务倒是不急...”
他一边小声嘀咕，一边用铲子随意拨弄着路上的落叶。
按照宗门规矩，这类杂务并不一定要当天完成，只要最终验收合格，拖个一两天也行。
想到关口那位圆脸师兄随和的样子，龙涛确信对方不会计较自己偷点懒。
正当他盘算着如何应付今晚那个要命的系统任务时，前方山道拐角处突然出现一个坐着的人影。
龙涛心头一紧，几乎是条件反射般地完成了一整套行礼动作，低头、躬身、拱手，动作流畅得像是演练过千百遍。
没办法，接这个清扫任务的就自己一人，那此刻出现在无风崖的，最差也是前来试炼的筑基弟子，甚至可能是来剖妖丹的金丹大佬，无论是谁，先装孙子总不会错。
“这位师兄不必如此。”

一个充满少年感的声音在头顶响起，语气中还带着几分歉意。
content_en:
Jiuxia Tianzong, as the dominant super sect, was formed by the merger of three major sects. Its scale is so large that it can be called a small country.
Not only does it govern a territory with a radius of thousands of miles, but the territory under it is almost all geomantic resources treasure land. Hundreds of towns and villages are dotted here and there. There are even three mortal towns located within the sect's mountain gate. The atmosphere of fireworks is stronger than that of many secular towns.
Long Tao had roughly estimated that the territory under the sect's jurisdiction was about the size of a province in the previous life, and the core territory, that is, the sect's hinterland within the traditional mountain gate, was probably slightly larger than a second-tier city.
Although compared with those well-known dynasties, this size is very small, but for a sect, the more territory and population the better, just enough is enough, the ground and resources are the key.
But if ordinary people want to move around in a city-sized sect, it is obviously impractical to rely on legs alone.
Fortunately, the sect has a complete transportation system, from cloud boats of different sizes to teleportation arrays between peaks.
Low-level disciples like Long Tao most often ride a medium-sized cloud boat that flies along a fixed route, which is similar to the bus in the previous life.
This thing is cheap and notoriously slow. By the time Long Tao reaches Wufeng Cliff, he doesn't even have to look up at the sun.
"Yo!
It’s time to wait for a qi training disciple to take on the cleaning task! "
The senior brother stationed at the pass was a round-faced man. After hearing about Long Tao's intention to come, he immediately greeted him warmly.
Long Tao was a little surprised.
He originally thought that his identity would be ignored, but he didn't expect the other party's attitude to be so warm.
"Senior brother, aren't there some foundation-building disciples from the trial who are responsible for cleaning here?"
"Ouch!
Forget it! "
The round-faced senior brother waved his hands with a disgusted expression, "Most of those guys were scarred after the trial.
Even those who were not injured were exhausted.
Even if we wave the broom twice, we can't say anything. "
As he spoke, he took out a jade slip from his sleeve, touched it lightly on Long Tao's waist badge, and recorded the mission information.
"After passing the floating bridge at the back, even if you have officially entered Windless Cliff, you can just clean up along the mountain road. There are wasteland and gravel at the bottom of the mountain. Don't worry about it. Just clean up the dead branches and leaves on the road. You can just throw them down the mountain."
The round-faced senior brother said and handed him a shovel and a relatively new hatchet.
"I know, but I won't accidentally run into the trial area, right?"
Although the purpose of this trip was to get into the trial area, he still asked instinctively.
"Don't worry about it. There are boundary markers around the trial area to remind you. Unless you are illiterate, you will never break in by mistake. Moreover, the monsters on the windless cliff like the windless environment and will not run down the mountain randomly."
After asking some more detailed questions, Long Tao said goodbye to the janitor brother and walked across the floating bridge carrying the shovel and hatchet.
Although this place is called Windless Cliff, the real windlessness is on the mountain. There is still a lot of mountain wind on the mountainside, and it is close to the pass, so the road ahead is quite clean and there is no need for him to do anything.
But after walking upward for about two-quarters of an hour, the situation changed. The originally strong mountain wind gradually weakened, and dead branches and leaves began to accumulate on the road, which could no longer be blown away by the wind.
Although he was forced by the system this time, he still had to do the work he had to do. Long Tao picked up the shovel and began to shovel all kinds of branches and debris on the road to the side of the road, or simply throw them under the cliff.
Along the way, I also saw a few piles of feces, which were probably pulled down by the monsters on the top of the mountain. This stuff is a good thing for disciples like them in the Qi training period, because there are likely to be some spiritual fruit cores or undigested spiritual herbs in the feces, which is an absolute windfall.
This time he was really lucky. After rummaging around with a hatchet, he found several fruit cores with spiritual energy in a few piles of feces. Some of them had quite a spiritual energy.Rich.
He carefully put the fruit cores into the bag on his waist and glanced to the west. The sun was about to set now.
"The cleaning task is not urgent..."
He murmured softly while flicking the fallen leaves on the road with his shovel.
According to the sect's rules, this kind of chores do not have to be completed on the same day. As long as the final acceptance is passed, it can be delayed for a day or two.
Thinking of the easy-going look of the round-faced senior brother at Guankou, Long Tao was sure that the other party would not care about his laziness.
Just as he was thinking about how to deal with tonight's fatal system task, a seated figure suddenly appeared at the corner of the mountain road ahead.
Long Tao's heart tightened, and he almost reflexively completed a set of salute movements, lowering his head, bowing, and cupping his hands. The movements were as smooth as if they had been practiced thousands of times.
There is no way, I am the only one who takes on this cleaning task. The one who appears at Wufengya at this moment is at worst a foundation-building disciple who comes to test, or even a golden elixir boss who comes to dissect the demon elixir. No matter who it is, it will never be wrong to pretend to be a grandson first.
"This senior brother doesn't have to be like this."
A boyish voice sounded above his head, with a hint of apology in his tone.
